## Introduction

Exploring the iris dataset with ggplot2 visualizations.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(ggplot2)
```

## Scatter Plot with Regression Line

```{r}
#| label: scatter-regression

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Petal Dimensions Relationship",
       x = "Petal Length (cm),
       y = "Petal Width (cm)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Density Plot

```{r}
#| label: density-plot

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Width, fill = Species)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Sepal Width Density by Species",
       x = "Sepal Width (cm)",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_light() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set10")
```

## Faceted Scatter Plots

```{r}
#| label: faceted-plots

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ Species) +
  labs(title = "Sepal Dimensions by Species",
       x = "Sepal Length (cm)",
       y = "Sepal Width (cm)") +
  theme_bw()
```

## Statistical Summary

```{r}
#| label: stats

# Calculate correlation
cor(iris$Petal.Length, iris$Petal.Width)

# Display structure
str(iris)

# Calculate variance
var(iris$Sepal.Lenght)
```
